description: Change an existing trigger: probe.params, probe.interval, probe.timeout, probe.access, probe.permissions, for, policy, action, target (kind, cwd), notify, name or intent. The change takes effect at once and the firing rules start over. To change the probe code or the mode, use trigger_draft with replace=true instead.

changes.description: The fields to change, shaped like the definition, for example {"probe": {"params": {"threshold": 210}}}. null removes a field.

trigger_id.description: The trigger id, as shown by trigger_list.

name: trigger_update
